scenes.name: TOP VIEW
lines: Here is a disc lying flat on a table, seen from above, with a small peg standing at its rim.
桌上平放着一个圆盘，我们从正上方往下看；圆盘边缘立着一根小木桩。
The disc turns steadily, counterclockwise. It is always a whole flat surface; the peg is one point on its edge.
圆盘匀速地逆时针转动。它始终是一整张平面，木桩只是它边缘上的一个点。

scenes.name: EDGE VIEW
lines: Now lower your eye to table level, and look at the same disc from the side.
现在把眼睛降到桌面的高度，从侧面看同一个圆盘。
Model this view as a straight projection: each point keeps its left-right position and loses its depth.
把这种看法当作正交投影的模型：每一点保留左右位置，丢掉前后深度。
So the shadow of the disc is a line segment, and the shadow of the peg is a point.
于是，圆盘的影子是一段线，木桩的影子是一个点。

scenes.name: ONE LAP
lines: Follow one slow lap. The peg on the disc keeps the same speed all the way round.
慢慢跟着走一圈。圆盘上的木桩一路保持同样的速度。
Its shadow does not. It races through the middle, slows near the ends, stops, and turns back.
它的影子却不是这样：在中间飞快穿过，靠近两端变慢，停住，再掉头。
One angle, theta, tells where the peg is. The shadow sits at x equals cosine theta.
一个角 θ 就说明木桩在哪里；影子的位置是 x = cos θ。
In units of the peg's speed, the shadow's velocity is minus sine theta, zero at both ends.
以木桩的恒定速度为单位，影子的速度是 −sin θ，在两端为零。

scenes.name: SAME SHADOW
lines: Compare two moments: the peg at ninety degrees, and the peg at two hundred seventy degrees.
比较两个时刻：木桩在 90°，以及木桩在 270°。
Both shadows sit in the middle, at x equals zero. Yet one heads left, the other right.
两个影子都落在正中，x = 0；可一个往左走，一个往右走。
Turn both forward by the same small angle, fifteen degrees, and the two shadows split apart.
让两者都再前进同样的小角度 15°，两个影子随即分开。
The shadows started at one position, but that does not mean the original states were the same.
两个影子起初在同一位置，但这并不代表原来的状态相同。

scenes.name: LIFT YOUR EYES
lines: Lift your eyes, and the line opens back into the disc. Now read two numbers, not one.
抬起视线，线段重新展开成圆盘。现在读两个数，而不是一个。
Across, x equals cosine theta. In the hidden direction, y equals sine theta: plus one at ninety, minus one at two seventy.
左右方向 x = cos θ；被藏起来的方向 y = sin θ：90° 处为 +1，270° 处为 −1。
No extra spring acts on the shadow: the steady turn, seen whole, explains every stop and reversal.
影子上没有额外的弹簧：把匀速转动看完整，每一次停住与掉头都有了解释。
One caution. This is an illustration of lost information, not a derivation of quantum mechanics.
提醒一句：这只是信息丢失的示意，不是对量子力学的推导。

scenes.name: NEXT STEP
lines: The prelude goes on to explore a sphere. Keep asking which parts of a shape a view can hide.
序曲接下来还会探索球面。继续问：一种看法会把物体的哪些部分藏起来？
Each time, ask first what the view shows, then what it leaves out. Then read on in the prelude.
每一次，先问看见了什么，再问漏掉了什么；然后接着读序曲。
